input: Sign up for a pottery throwing masterclass

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Pottery Throwing Masterclass
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a pottery throwing masterclass.

questions.title: What city or area should the class be in?
questions.description: Determine the user's preferred location for the in-person class, or whether online is acceptable.

questions.title: Do you have a specific budget per class in mind?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit to filter suitable masterclass options.

questions.title: What is your current skill level in pottery?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is a complete beginner, has some experience, or is intermediate, to match the right masterclass level.

questions.title: Are there specific dates or days you are available?
questions.description: Identify scheduling constraints such as weekends only, evenings, or a particular date range.

questions.title: Do you prefer a single session or a multi-week course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a one-off masterclass experience or an ongoing series of sessions.

questions.title: Is there a particular pottery style or technique you want to focus on?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a specific goal such as wheel throwing, hand-building, glazing, or a general introduction.

questions.title: Will you be signing up alone or as part of a group?
questions.description: Determine if this is a solo booking or if the user needs spots for multiple people, which may affect class type and availability.
